recentItems.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
recentItems.description:
The Saudi-led coalition says it has intercepted and destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launched towards Saudi Arabia’s capital, Riyadh.
Yemen's Ansarullah Houthis say their operations targeting Saudi airports and oil facilities will continue in the coming days.

Al Jazeera’s Zein Basravi has more from Qatar's capital Doha and Yousef Mawry is monitoring developments from Yemen's capital, Sanaa

recentItems.title: ‘We live life in fear’: Palestinian girl faces Israeli settler pogroms going to school
recentItems.description:
Around 800,000 Palestinian children in the occupied West Bank face barriers to education, including disrupted classes, checkpoints, violence, and school demolitions. 
Al Jazeera follows Farah Jabarin, a 16-year-old student from Masafer Yatta from her recently attacked home to her school, partly demolished during the summer break. 
Here is Farah’s story, in her own words.

recentItems.title: Israeli strike on Gaza City apartment kills Palestinian woman, daughter rescued
recentItems.description:
An Israeli air strike on a residential block in Gaza City has killed one woman.
The rescue of her daughter was captured on camera. The attack happened in the Rimal neighbourhood of Gaza City.
Elsewhere in the city, there are reports of heavy gunfire targeting vehicles and people.
There are near daily attacks on Gaza despite a US-brokered ceasefire which took effect more than a year ago. 

Al Jazeera’s Ibrahim al-Khalili reports from Gaza City.
